quiz.title: Cloud Platforms for Data Engineering (AWS, GCP, Azure)
quiz.description: Core cloud concepts and services across AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Azure relevant to data engineering.

questions.question_text: What does 'IaaS' (Infrastructure as a Service) provide to a customer?
questions.option_a: Virtualized computing resources like servers and storage managed over the internet
questions.option_b: A fully finished application with no configuration needed
questions.correct_answer: Virtualized computing resources like servers and storage managed over the internet

questions.question_text: Which AWS service is a widely used object storage service?
Which AWS service provides a managed data warehouse?
Which Google Cloud Platform (GCP) service is a fully managed, serverless data warehouse?
Which GCP service provides scalable object storage similar to Amazon S3?
Which Azure service provides a managed relational database as a service?
Which Azure service is used for scalable, unstructured object storage?
What is the main purpose of a managed orchestration service like AWS Step Functions, GCP's Cloud Composer, or Azure Data Factory?
questions.option_a: Coordinating and automating multi-step data workflows in the cloud
questions.option_d: Replacing the need for any compute resources
questions.correct_answer: Coordinating and automating multi-step data workflows in the cloud

questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of using cloud-managed services (e.g., managed Kafka or Spark) instead of self-hosting?
questions.option_a: Reduced operational overhead since the provider handles scaling, patching, and infrastructure
questions.option_c: They eliminate the need to write any code
questions.option_d: They only work with a single cloud region
questions.correct_answer: Reduced operational overhead since the provider handles scaling, patching, and infrastructure

questions.question_text: What does 'serverless' mean, as in AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Functions, or Azure Functions?
questions.option_a: The cloud provider automatically manages the underlying servers, and code runs in response to events
questions.option_b: There are no servers involved anywhere in the world
questions.option_c: The code must run on the developer's own laptop
questions.option_d: It only refers to static websites
questions.correct_answer: The cloud provider automatically manages the underlying servers, and code runs in response to events

questions.question_text: Why might a data engineering team choose a multi-cloud or cloud-agnostic approach for parts of their pipeline?
questions.option_a: To avoid vendor lock-in and increase flexibility, though it can add complexity
questions.option_b: Because using more than one cloud provider is required by law
questions.option_c: Because a single cloud provider cannot store any data
questions.option_d: Because multi-cloud always reduces cost with no trade-offs
questions.correct_answer: To avoid vendor lock-in and increase flexibility, though it can add complexity

questions.question_text: Which concept describes paying only for the cloud resources actually consumed, rather than upfront hardware costs?
questions.option_d: Flat one-time-only fee for unlimited use forever
